tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe established a sign reversal at the target horizon, but each new point also changed u_now. A finer trajectory batch can distinguish a sharp onset from a gradual penalty and constrain the transition before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Saturating baseline with a quadratic gradient penalty above a threshold
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A fit can match the eight observations within tolerance, but its threshold and onset shape are not established: the baseline inputs co-vary, and there are only three points on the declining branch.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane self-inhibition or Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither recalled form can cross zero on these positive inputs.
It does not resolve the gradient threshold or the shape of the declining branch.
